title: Uncaught Error: Minified exception occurred; use the non-minified dev environment for the full error message and additional helpful warnings.
body:
I've disabled all of our other javascript, so we are just using the instantsearch.js code as in the examples.  No matter what I do (search, click a page, etc) I am always getting this error.    This error is coming from the invariant.js script.   Unsure if this is just a configuration issue or what.   Just trying to do a pretty basic setup with a search box, hits container, and pagination.

Should mention that the initial render works fine, it's populating the first page of results as it should.  Just can't do anything from there.

comments.body: Hi @ricktbaker are you able to share with us a setup where we can see the issue?
Unfortunately not at the moment as it's in our private dev environment.    But I will see if I can get it on a public server to share.

Can you give me some more details about your setup:
- are you using browserify or webpack?
- what is the version of instantsearch.js (either from your node_modules/instantsearch.js or instantsearch.version in window)

No on browserify and webpack:

Versions, just copying direct from the algolia website documentation:

```
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="//cdn.jsdelivr.net/instantsearch.js/1/instantsearch.min.css">
<script src="//cdn.jsdelivr.net/instantsearch.js/1/instantsearch.min.js"></script>
```
Will take a look at that stackoverflow.   Thanks!
If you are able to provide us an [ngrok](https://ngrok.com/) url for us to see your issue (via support maybe: support@algolia.com) it would be good so that we can see the issue
Ok, if I can't get it resolved here in a bit, then I'll go that route and send to support.  Thanks again.
Just sent an email with a fwd to my local dev.

This issue was due to a missing `` in a template. For reference when using React's dangerouslySetInnerHTML, the html should we well formed: https://facebook.github.io/react/tips/dangerously-set-inner-html.html Thanks!
